description: Finite-frequency modal limit from positive airspeed; exact stagnation and experimental parity remain unresolved.

reference.description: Primary-source aerodynamic settings and low-speed asymptotic specification for the Durrant wing reconstruction.

aerodynamics.source: Durrant (2024), Table 3.11, printed page 67 / PDF page 80; visually checked.

limit.source: Drela ASWING 5.99 Unsteady Extension, 10 March 2015, equations 33-35, 41-44, 49-56; PDF pages 8-11.
limit.path: Positive speed tending to zero at fixed nonzero structural frequency, fixed density, zero gravity; linearize each solved equilibrium before taking the limit.
limit.retained_surface_inertia: Normal mass per span rho*pi*c^2/4 at midchord, plus span-axis rotary inertia per span rho*pi*c^4/128.
limit.circulation: With lag enabled, finite-frequency circulation amplitude is O(U) for a fixed mechanical disturbance; circulatory/rate loads vanish as U tends to zero. Slow aerodynamic roots tend to zero separately.
limits_not_equivalent: A fixed nonzero mean-flow calculation is not an exact zero-speed solution.
Zero-frequency/DC and zero-speed limits cannot be interchanged without analysis.
A finite-amplitude nonlinear launch from exact stagnation is not established by this modal limit.

conventions.wing_orientation: Undeformed span is +z, chord +x, physical normal -y; positive incidence is beta, not alpha.
conventions.baseline: Zero body alpha/beta, 1.225 kg/m^3, fixed PG Mach zero, no gravity, controls or engines, K/F off, K/W default. Case 4 supplies section camber and pitching moment.
conventions.source_identity: Uses the published main-table structure, not the incompatible appendix input; original GVT/ASWING setup conflicts remain.
